occoquan-bible-church.assessment: Occoquan Bible Church (Woodbridge/Lake Ridge, VA) is an elder-led Baptist congregation with David Schrock as Pastor of Preaching & Theology. Public Statement of Faith (obc.org/beliefs) confesses the Five Solas, stands in general agreement with the 1689 LBCF, and upholds Chicago Inerrancy (1978), Danvers (1987), Nashville (2017), and the Dallas Statement on Social Justice and the Gospel (2018). Male-only elder-pastors per staff page (1 Tim 3; Titus 1; 1 Pet 5). Related teaching ministry: Christ Over All (christoverall.com) — multi-author pastor-theologian fellowship with founding ties to OBC elders Schrock, Bridges, and Fillinger; not a second campus. Zone GREEN on documented confessional markers. Sources: obc.org/beliefs; obc.org/pastors-and-staff; christoverall.com.

score_notes.christology: OBC Statement of Faith rooted in Apostles’ Creed, Nicene Creed, and Definition of Chalcedon; Jesus Christ is Lord. Source: https://obc.org/beliefs (verified 2026-07-14).
score_notes.scripture: OBC upholds Chicago Statement on Biblical Inerrancy (1978); church built on unchangeable truth of Christ’s Word; general agreement with 1689 LBCF. Source: https://obc.org/beliefs.
score_notes.soteriology: Preface: salvation only by grace through faith in the finished work of Christ’s death and resurrection; Five Solas of the Reformation confessed. Source: https://obc.org/beliefs.
score_notes.gender: Male-only pastors/elders (1 Tim 3; Titus 1; 1 Pet 5 language on staff page). OBC Statement of Faith upholds Danvers Statement on Biblical Complementarity (1987) and Nashville Statement on Biblical Sexuality (2017). Source: https://obc.org/beliefs; https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff.
score_notes.leadership: Elder-led plurality of male pastors only; staff page equates pastor/elder/bishop and cites 1 Tim 3; Titus 1; 1 Pet 5. Pastors: David Schrock (Preaching & Theology), Jared Bridges (Youth), Rod Fillinger (Spiritual Care), Jeff Dionise (Outreach), Sean Oxford (Children's), Ben Purves (Community & Member Care). Matt Wood Pastoral Assistant (staff), not elder. Source: https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff.
score_notes.preaching: Schrock is Pastor of Preaching & Theology (PhD Systematic Theology, SBTS); OBC invites hearers to its preaching/teaching ministry; COA Editor-in-Chief / Reformed Baptist expositional culture. Sources: https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff; https://obc.org.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Schrock oversees Men’s and Women’s Ministries per staff page; Men’s Ministry flag Yes. Source: https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff.
score_notes.mission: Homepage: family of believers proclaiming the good news of Jesus to Northern Virginia; Pastor of Outreach (Dionise) + community outreach oversight. Sources: https://obc.org; https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff.
score_notes.cultural: OBC Statement of Faith upholds Dallas Statement on Social Justice and the Gospel (2018) alongside Danvers + Nashville — clear anti-woke / biblical anthropology marker. Source: https://obc.org/beliefs.
score_notes.denominational: SBC-tagged / SBCV listed Baptist congregation; general agreement with London Baptist Confession of 1689; elder-led local church. Sources: https://obc.org/beliefs; SBCV listing.

occoquan-bible-church.gender_detail: Male-only pastors/elders; OBC Statement of Faith upholds Danvers (1987) and Nashville (2017). Deacons may be male or female per prior staff language. Source: https://obc.org/beliefs; https://obc.org/pastors-and-staff.
occoquan-bible-church.pastor_credentials: PhD Systematic Theology, The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary; MDiv SBTS; BA Albion College

oceanside-christian-fellowship-el-segund.assessment: Oceanside Christian Fellowship is an EFCA + Acts 29 dual-affiliated church in El Segundo, CA (LA County). Lead Pastor Brandon Cash co-hosted an Acts 29 Podcast episode with David Fandey on church planting cadence. Mission: 'passionately pursue God, healthy relationships with each other, and people who don't know Jesus.'

oceanside-urc-ca.assessment: Oceanside URC is a well-established Southern California URCNA congregation pastored by Rev. Dr. Michael Brown, a widely read author on confessional Reformed theology. The church practices traditional two-service Lord's Day worship with morning expository preaching and evening Heidelberg Catechism preaching. Male-only officers, Three Forms of Unity subscription, and a serious catechetical culture mark this congregation as a strong confessional Reformed home.

score_notes.scripture: Confessional view of Scripture — inerrant and sufficient.
score_notes.leadership: Pastor Danny (Dr. Daniel R. Hyde) confirmed as lead pastor; plurality of male elders per URCNA polity (Polity section exists on site).
score_notes.cultural: Confessional/confessing congregation; Acts 2:42 emphasis; psalm-singing and traditional Reformed worship — resists cultural drift.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: 'Anchored: Men's Ministry' confirmed as dedicated nav item.
score_notes.denominational: URCNA confirmed in footer — United Reformed Churches in North America; classis accountability intact.
